name: Mardi Gras Hotel & Casino

sources.observed: Official front and pool gallery inspected; ochre stucco, bronze mansard, iron rails, cream decks, blue pool tile and terracotta coping.
November 2021 front panorama: three storeys, exterior corridors, arched openings, deep canopy, slender columns and stone bases.
Aerial inspected: two parallel wings, west connector, separate courtyard building, pool toward eastern half; image capture date unspecified.
Official pool image inspected: blue tile, terracotta coping, scalloped outline, cream deck, blue loungers and steel handrails.
Official exterior corridor detail inspected: rough stucco arch and iron balustrade.
Official site-6 and site-4 images inspected; machine closeups only, no reliable room layout. Interior remains deferred.

Evening courtyard photograph inspected: exposed straight stair with intermediate landing beside taller pavilion, upper terrace rails and connections toward guest corridors. Capture date unknown; historic Wynn skyline.
Daylight photograph independently shows exposed stair beside pavilion and upper terrace; image date unknown, older furnishings. Used for permanent circulation only.

Official first/second/third floor PDFs all downloaded from linked legacy host and visually inspected. Schematic guest room numbering, west reception/casino/restaurant, central New Orleans Pavilion and Baton Rouge North/South, second-floor guest laundry. No stair symbols or dimensioned circulation; repeated central diagram on all floors cannot establish pavilion elevations.

Photo-supported two-flight exposed stair, intermediate and upper landings, upper terrace and corridor rail openings, taller central pavilion and east glazing.
remaining: Meeting plan now supports pavilion partition/door layout; interior not built. Ceiling elevations and finishes need photo corroboration. Lobby/casino room layout remains schematic.

Middle-floor access still unlocated; exposed stair to upper terrace and corridor now built and walked. Roof standing seams, sign typography, stone bases, courtyard greenery/fencing and surface detail need refinement.
Pool dimensions and room rhythm inferred; pavilion materials and furnishing detail remain simplified. No photorealistic completion claim.
Water animates at a fixed camera; reference caustics, tile definition, lounger construction, planting and pavilion finish remain more detailed than this installed pass.

Reconcile stair riser count and pavilion/terrace elevation against clearer photographs before architectural acceptance: current6.26m elevation and12.4m stair run remain photo-fitted estimates, not confirmed by the schematic maps. Terrace soffit/edge thickness also needs refinement.
